arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, copy
BASE={"cases":[{"initial":[["::/0",3]],"transactions":[],"bursts":[],"cache_pages":0,
        "costs":{"hit":1,"miss":8,"decode":[0,1,2]}}]}
def run(p):
    if not isinstance(p,bytes): p=json.dumps(p).encode()
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=p,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return r.returncode, r.stdout.decode().strip()[:60], r.stderr.decode()[:100]
cases=[]
def mut(f,name):
    c=copy.deepcopy(BASE); f(c); cases.append((name,c))
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(transactions=[[["set","::/0",3]],"x"]), "tx not list")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(initial="abc"), "initial not list")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["bursts"].append({"version":0,"repeat":1,"addresses":"::"}), "addresses not list")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["costs"].update(decode="012"), "decode not list")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(cache_pages="2"), "cache_pages str")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(initial=[["::/true",3]]), "prefix bool length")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(initial=[["::/0",3.0]]), "hop float")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["bursts"].append({"version":0,"repeat":1.0,"addresses":[]}), "repeat float")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["bursts"].append({"version":0,"repeat":1,"addresses":[None]}), "address null")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(initial=[[["::/0"],3]]), "prefix as list")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(costs=[1,8,[0,1,2]]), "costs as list")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"].append("x"), "case not dict")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["bursts"].append({"version":"0","repeat":1,"addresses":[]}), "version str")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(initial=[["::/0",3],["::/0"]]), "short row")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["costs"].update(decode=[0,1,17]), "decode 17")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0]["costs"].update(decode=[0,1,-1]), "decode -1")
mut(lambda c: c["cases"][0].update(initial=[["::/0",2147483647],["::1/128",2147483647]]), "hop max ok")
deep = '{"cases":' + '['*100 + ']'*100 + '}'
bad=0
for name,payload in cases:
    rc,out,err=run(payload)
    expect_ok = name=="hop max ok"
    good = (rc==0) and (out.startswith('{"cases":[{"versions"') if expect_ok else out=='{"error":"invalid"}')
    if not good: bad+=1; print("FAIL",name,rc,out,err)
rc,out,err=run(deep.encode())
print("deep nesting:",rc,out)
print("bad:",bad)
# 60001 initial rows
big=copy.deepcopy(BASE)
big["cases"][0]["initial"]=[["::%x/128"%i,1] for i in range(60001)]
print("60001 rows:", run(big)[1])
big2=copy.deepcopy(BASE)
big2["cases"][0]["initial"]=[["::%x/128"%i,1] for i in range(30001)]
print("30001 active:", run(big2)[1])
PYEOF
